bodies.tab:system:constraints:
Reach    & The arm can reach both the object's current position and the
               task's destination zone. \\
    Grasp    & The object's grasp width in its current pose does not exceed the
               arm's gripper aperture. \\
    Delicacy & An object flagged delicate is assigned only to an arm cleared
               for delicate handling. \\
    Payload  & The object's mass does not exceed the arm's payload limit. \\
    Route    & The path the task requires is available to that arm, accounting
               for zone occupancy. \\
